text_en: Later the following events took place: Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard in Jezreel, beside the palace of King Ahab of Samaria.
text_cn: 这事以后，依次勒耳人纳波特在依次勒耳，靠近撒玛黎雅王阿哈布的宫殿，有一个葡萄园。

text_en: And Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard, so that I may have it for a vegetable garden, because it is near my house; I will give you a better vineyard for it; or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its value in money. ”
text_cn: 阿哈布对纳波特说：“请将你的葡萄园让给我，我可以用作菜园，因为离我的宫殿很近；我愿拿一个更好的葡萄园来与你交换；或者，如果你认为好，我也可以照葡萄园的价值给你钱。”

text_en: But Naboth said to Ahab, “The Lord forbid that I should give you my ancestral inheritance. ”
text_cn: 纳波特回答阿哈布说：“上主决不许我将我祖先的产业让给你！”

text_en: Ahab went home resentful and sullen because of what Naboth the Jezreelite had said to him; for he had said, “I will not give you my ancestral inheritance. ” He lay down on his bed, turned away his face, and would not eat.
text_cn: 阿哈布由于依次勒耳人纳波特对他所说：“我决不将我祖先的产业让给你”的话，便闷闷不乐地回到宫中，躺在床上，转过脸去，不肯吃饭。

text_en: His wife Jezebel came to him and said, “Why are you so depressed that you will not eat? ”
text_cn: 他的妻子依则贝耳来见他，问他说：“你为什么心里这样忧闷，连饭都不肯吃？”

text_en: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard for it’; but he answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard. ’”
text_cn: 阿哈布回答说：“因为我对依次勒耳人纳波特说：请将你的葡萄园按现价卖给我，或者如果你愿意，我可以拿另一个葡萄园来与你交换；他却回答说：我决不将我的葡萄园让给你。”

text_en: His wife Jezebel said to him, “Do you now govern Israel? Get up, eat some food, and be cheerful; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite. ”
text_cn: 他的妻子依则贝耳对他说：“你真会统治以色列！只管起来吃饭，心情愉快，我必将依次勒耳人纳波特的葡萄园交给你。”

text_en: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal; she sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
text_cn: 依则贝耳便以阿哈布的名义写了一封信，盖上君王的印章，送给与纳波特同住一城的长老和官绅，

text_en: She wrote in the letters, “Proclaim a fast, and seat Naboth at the head of the assembly;
text_cn: 信上写道：“请你们宣布禁食，叫纳波特坐上民众的首位，

text_en: seat two scoundrels opposite him, and have them bring a charge against him, saying, ‘You have cursed God and the king. ’ Then take him out, and stone him to death. ”
text_cn: 然后再叫两个流氓坐在他的对面，作证控告他说：纳波特辱骂了天主和君王，你们应将他拉出城外，用石头砸死。”

text_en: The men of his city, the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had sent word to them. Just as it was written in the letters that she had sent to them,
text_cn: 那些与纳波特同住在一城的长老和官绅，便照依则贝耳吩咐他们的，照她在送给他们的信上所写的去行：

text_en: they proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the head of the assembly.
text_cn: 宣布禁食，叫纳波特坐上民众的首位，

text_en: The two scoundrels came in and sat opposite him; and the scoundrels brought a charge against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king. ” So they took him outside the city, and stoned him to death.
text_cn: 两个流氓前来坐在他的对面，当众作证控告他说：“纳波特辱骂了天主和君王。”众人便将他拉出城外，用石头砸死了。

text_en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned; he is dead. ”
text_cn: 然后派人告诉依则贝耳说：“纳波特已用石头砸死了。”

text_en: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Go, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead. ”
text_cn: 依则贝耳听说纳波特已用石头砸死了，就对阿哈布说：“你起来，去占领依次勒耳人纳波特，先前不肯照现价卖给你的葡萄园，因为纳波特已经不在了，已经死了。”

text_en: As soon as Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab set out to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
text_cn: 阿哈布一听说纳波特死了，就起身下到依次勒耳人纳波特的葡萄园，霸占了那葡萄园。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying:
text_cn: 那时，有上主的话传于提市贝人厄里亚说：

text_en: Go down to meet King Ahab of Israel, who rules in Samaria; he is now in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to take possession.
text_cn: “你起来，下去会晤住在撒玛黎雅的以色列王阿哈布；看，他现在正在纳波特的葡萄园内，他下到那里去霸占了那葡萄园。

text_en: You shall say to him, “Thus says the Lord : Have you killed, and also taken possession? ” You shall say to him, “Thus says the Lord : In the place where dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, dogs will also lick up your blood. ”
text_cn: 你要对他说：上主这样说：你杀了人，还要霸占他的产业吗？继而对他说：上主这样说：狗在什么地方，舔了纳波特的血，也要在什么地方舔你的血。”

text_en: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, O my enemy? ” He answered, “I have found you. Because you have sold yourself to do what is evil in the sight of the Lord ,
text_cn: 阿哈布对厄里亚说：“我的对头，你又找到了我的错吗？”厄里亚答说：“是，我找到了你的错，因为你出卖了你自己，去行上主视为恶的事。

text_en: I will bring disaster on you; I will consume you, and will cut off from Ahab every male, bond or free, in Israel;
text_cn: 我必要在你身上降灾，消灭你的宗族；以色列所有属于阿哈布的男子无论是自由的或不自由的，一概灭绝。

text_en: and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked me to anger and have caused Israel to sin.
text_cn: 我要使你的家像乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕的家，又像阿希雅的儿子巴厄沙的家，因为你惹我发怒，使以色列陷于罪恶。

text_en: Also concerning Jezebel the Lord said, ‘The dogs shall eat Jezebel within the bounds of Jezreel. ’
text_cn: 至于依则贝耳，上主也预告说：狗要在依次勒耳的田间，吞食依则贝耳。

text_en: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city the dogs shall eat; and anyone of his who dies in the open country the birds of the air shall eat. ”
text_cn: 凡属阿哈布的人，死在城中的，要为狗吞食，死在田间的，要为空中的飞鸟啄食。”

text_en: (Indeed, there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do what was evil in the sight of the Lord , urged on by his wife Jezebel.
text_cn: 实在，从来没有人像阿哈布一样，受他的妻子依则贝耳的引诱，这样出卖自己，行上主视为恶的事。

text_en: He acted most abominably in going after idols, as the Amorites had done, whom the Lord drove out before the Israelites. )
text_cn: 他行了最可憎恶的事，归依了邪神偶像，全像上主从以色列子民前，赶走的阿摩黎人所行的一样。

text_en: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes and put sackcloth over his bare flesh; he fasted, lay in the sackcloth, and went about dejectedly.
text_cn: 阿哈布一听这些话，就撕破自己的衣服，身穿麻衣，禁食，穿着麻衣睡觉，低头缓步行走。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:
text_cn: 于是有上主的话传于提市贝人厄里亚说：

text_en: “Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself before me, I will not bring the disaster in his days; but in his son’s days I will bring the disaster on his house. ”
text_cn: “阿哈布在我面前这样自卑自贱，你看见了没有？他既然在我面前自卑自贱，在他有生之日，我不降此灾祸；但是，到他儿子的日子，我要使这灾祸临于他家。”
